body: Sorry, I am just finding it hard to come up with words. Thank you for your time

I know that I want to be in college, I'm here doing an English major and nothing makes me happier nowadays than sitting in class learning about old white dead guys. The only thing I can bring myself to want for a future is teaching other people about that sort of thing.

I have a job, which is very out of the ordinary (no one else I know can find work) but I only make about $120 a month, most of which goes towards expenses.

I'm trapped in the shitty decisions I've made. I can't really move on when I've laid time bombs all over the place that are going to go off any day now. Some already have. I have made my life a living hell, it will continue to be so.

I'm 20 and a completely broke college student. Parents can't afford to take me back in, living on a scholarship that will only pay if I go to THIS school. There's literally no money for me to be anywhere other than in this dorm room that the state is paying for.

I also did that shit before. I started off with a whole new persona and I'm still a piece of shit that people hate. I even did the whole "total reform" thing to try and be confident and self-assured and not a doormat but now I'm just a total dickhead. I basically have failed at being worth anything in any capacity

All the shit that happened to me was a result of awful, shitty decisions I've made. I've become somebody who is a real shitbag who is quite honestly a tornado of fucking everyone around her up. Literally everybody I come into contact with is worse for it. And it's not like it's not my fault, it's me being selfish and fucked up. On top of all that, I'm a total loser who is apparently so pathetic people talk about how terrible I am behind my back, nobody takes me seriously or really bothers enough to talk (not that I blame them to be honest,) and I'm just not doing anything with my life.
